name: Bug report: composite triage
state: After updating to 4.2.1 the export button does nothing on macOS. Console shows `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'blob')` in export.js:214. Reloading does not help. Exporting from the old 4.1.9 build still works, so we downgraded for now. Happens for all three people on my team.

severity.instructions: How severe is the reported issue?
criteria: Broken or degraded feature, but a workaround exists

actionable.instructions: How much does the report give an engineer to work with?
criteria: clear reproduction steps or error messages

regression.instructions: Does the report describe a regression, something that used to work in an earlier version?

area.instructions: Which part of the product is affected?

risk.instructions: How risky is running this shell command?

criteria.safe: read-only, or creates files without touching existing ones; nothing to undo
criteria.caution: changes files, packages or settings but can be undone or redone
criteria.destructive: deletes or overwrites data, or changes that are hard to reverse

needs_confirmation.instructions: Should an assistant ask the user to confirm before running this command?

reversible.instructions: How reversible is the effect of this command?

name: Situation: firefighter, one critical action
state: You are advancing down a narrow hallway with a charged hose line toward a bedroom door 10 feet ahead. Thick black smoke is rolling out of the doorway at the ceiling and the heat has suddenly spiked; you hear a rising whooshing sound. Your partner is 20 feet behind you at the stairwell.

action.instructions: What is the most critical action to take right now?

criteria.advance: push forward and force the bedroom door to search it
criteria.cool_ceiling: drop low and apply a stream to the ceiling to cool the gas layer
criteria.retreat: withdraw toward the stairwell and your partner immediately
criteria.call_command: stop and radio command for instructions

flashover_imminent.instructions: Do the signs indicate an imminent flashover?

danger.instructions: How dangerous is the situation for the firefighter?

action.instructions: What should moderation do with this comment?

criteria.hide: hide it from the thread but keep the account

criteria.ban: remove it and ban the account

harassment.instructions: How harassing is the comment toward the post's author?

illegal_goods.instructions: Does the comment offer illegal goods or services?
